svg.text: One configuration file and one CLI create the Azure resources; from then on Git is the source of truth and Argo CD runs the platform.
Bicep, one deployment stack per module and environment
Azure CNI Overlay + Cilium · Entra ID only · Workload Identity
created from apps/<app>.yaml · Pod Security restricted
signed images pinned by digest; ConfigMaps from the platform APIs
signed images pinned by digest; ConfigMaps from the platform APIs
The app team opens a pull request (by hand or from a portal template).
On merge, the golden path checks, builds and scans the images.
It pushes them to the registry with an SBOM and provenance, signed with Cosign (OIDC, no secrets).
Kargo sees the new images in the registry ...
... and commits their digests to the stage's values file (dev automatically, later stages on request).
Argo CD syncs the platform and every app from the repository.
Kyverno admits only images signed by the golden path, and each app only its own.
Users reach apps through Envoy Gateway, with Let's Encrypt certificates and records in Azure DNS.
The platform engineer runs bluepave up once: Bicep stacks, identities, the GitHub App, then Argo CD.
